smartcolony.chat.founded: Colony %s founded: %s villagers joined, the storage stands next to the bell.
smartcolony.chat.death: A %s of the colony has died.
smartcolony.chat.birth: A child was born in the colony.
smartcolony.chat.golem: The colony forged an iron golem from %s ingots.
smartcolony.chat.market: The market closed %s deals with the colony traders.
smartcolony.chat.theft: The colony saw you take goods from its storage without paying. Reputation %s (now %s, %s).
smartcolony.chat.donation: The colony thanks you for the donation. Reputation %s (now %s, %s).
smartcolony.chat.purchase: Purchase accepted: the emeralds cover the goods.
smartcolony.chat.vandal: You broke a storage container of the colony. Reputation %s (now %s, %s).
smartcolony.chat.murder: You killed a villager of the colony. Reputation %s (now %s, %s).
smartcolony.chat.assault: You attacked a villager of the colony. Reputation %s (now %s, %s).
smartcolony.chat.enemy: Guards and golems will now attack you. Pay or donate to the storage to restore your name.
smartcolony.chat.forgiven: The colony no longer treats you as an enemy.
smartcolony.command.none: No colony nearby. Stand near a village bell and run /colony found.
smartcolony.command.population: Members: %s (children: %s), beds in colony houses: %s, buildings: %s
smartcolony.command.no_site: No room for the colony storage near the bell. The hologram in front of you shows it: green is the storage, red is what is in the way. Face open ground and run /colony found here.
smartcolony.command.site_blocked: The storage does not fit in front of you: %s. Check the hologram, then turn or move and try again.
smartcolony.site.blocked: %s blocks of buildings or farms in the way (red)
smartcolony.site.steep: the ground is too steep, more than 4 blocks of height difference
smartcolony.site.water: there is water on the spot
smartcolony.site.unloaded: The place in front of you is not loaded yet.
smartcolony.command.disbanded: Colony %s disbanded. Villagers returned to vanilla behaviour; buildings stay.
smartcolony.command.busy: The colony is already building something. Wait until it finishes.
smartcolony.command.planned: Planned: %s. Builders start once the materials are in storage.
smartcolony.command.unknown_role: Unknown role %s. Use lumberjack, miner, farmer, fisherman, herder, builder, guard, idle or auto.
smartcolony.ui.title: Colony
smartcolony.ui.project_none: Nothing is being built right now.
smartcolony.ui.mine_none: No mine yet: it appears once a miner gets a pickaxe.
smartcolony.ui.singleplayer: The colony window works only in singleplayer.
